children: Overview
China property developer's H1 2026 revenue fell sharply yr/yr to RMB67.87 bln
Net income attributable to shareholders declined yr/yr to RMB9.84 bln
Company kept interim dividend flat at RMB0.20 per share
Outlook
Company says real estate market shows weak recovery but strong differentiation, with ongoing industry transition
Company expects recurring businesses to continue increasing as a share of overall results
Company maintains focus on expanding in core cities and value-accretive project opportunities
Result Drivers
DEVELOPMENT PROPERTY DELIVERY – Development-property revenue fell 39.1% yr/yr to RMB45.26 bln; booked GFA declined 38.3% to 1.98 mln square metres
CONTRACTED SALES - Development property business recorded contracted sales of RMB116.50 bln, up 5.6% yr/yr, with strong performance in key cities and projects
RECURRING BUSINESS GROWTH - Revenue from recurring businesses rose 9.9% yr/yr to RMB22.61 bln, making up 33.3% of total revenue
RENTAL BUSINESS EXPANSION - Investment property rental business revenue grew 17.0% yr/yr to RMB14.16 bln, driven by shopping mall retail sales and improved margins

Analyst Coverage
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 21 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the real estate rental, development & operations peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for China Resources Land Limited is HK$42.38, about 27.7% above its August 28 closing price of HK$33.18
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 8 three months ago
